description: GWAK 2.0 embedder (SimCLR, S4 backbone, multi-signal + background training) and background-only normalizing flow, exported as TorchScript. Anomaly score = -log_prob(embedding).
trained_by: fan.zhang on the CIT LDG cluster (home directory checkout, 2026)

metric.output: (batch,) log probability under the background flow

preprocessing.note: sample_rate, kernel_length, psd_length, fduration and fftlength come from the training config (train_config_S4_SimCLR_multiSignalAndBkg.yaml). highpass and stride are not in the exported config; 30 Hz matches the GWAK 1 bandpass and 1/16 s is the adapter default (a 0.25 s stride missed the 0.2 s chirp alignment on GW150914), both recorded in every manifest.

review_status: user-trained checkpoints, not a published ML4GW release; anomaly threshold uncalibrated until a background study
